ValidationRule.description: Force users to remove Additional Disc applied from Promo when Promo is removed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( ISBLANK( Product_Promotion__c ), Promo_Discount_Holder__c > 0, Customer_Discount__c == Promo_Discount_Holder__c), true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You removed the Product Promotion, please also remove ADDT'L Discount that was applied from the promotion.
